up: Retrieve all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5726550. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno. sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726550'
